name: OSC 1
behavior: Independent ADDAC701-inspired oscillator. Six-position octave control; continuous TUNE/FINE; LFO/VCO range, FM/PWM and soft/off/hard sync targets. Four raw waveforms.
engineering_to_finish: AS3340D plus required sine shaping is a candidate, not a complete core. Resolve V/oct scale/offset, octave ladder, switch bounce, FM topology, hard/soft sync, pulse and sine amplitudes, LFO limits, startup and factory calibration. No through-zero assumption.

name: FILTER 1
behavior: Parallel dry VCA OUT plus LP/BP/HP outputs. Frequency/resonance/gain controls and corresponding CV depth. No selector required.

name: MIX5 A
behavior: Five independent bipolar attenuverters feeding a mono sum, then manual LEVEL.
engineering_to_finish: Resolve gain normalization/headroom; not automatically divide by five. Indicator at each input and SUM; clip must reflect internal overload, not only attenuated output.

name: MIX4 A
behavior: Four attenuverters feed summing stage then VCA. ATTEN CV through CV± combines with manual SUM GAIN.
engineering_to_finish: ATTEN is control, not a fifth audio input. Preserve pre-VCA overload detection when final output is attenuated. Define VCA gain law and allowed input/CV ranges.

name: FOLD 2
behavior: IN -> fold/bias shaping -> level -> OUT. FOLD CV and BIAS CV as drawn.
engineering_to_finish: FOLD± affects FOLD CV. BIAS CV amount fixed unless a user-approved control is added; no undocumented knob. Define transfer curve, amplitude/offset limit and non-oscillatory behavior.

name: ENV 1
behavior: ASR/AR/LOOP; linear/curved; stage gate selection rise/fall; manual trigger. RISE/FALL pots with stage-gated ENV-strength lamps; ENV/BIP/EOC/STG outputs.
engineering_to_finish: Freeze SIG semantics and retrigger behavior in a truth table. The UI is ideal behavior only. Define trigger thresholds, EOC pulse duration, bipolar output scale and CV law. Never load timing capacitor with indicator.

name: OFFSET 1
behavior: OUT = gain * IN + manual offset + OFFSET CV, gain -1..+1 as intent.
engineering_to_finish: Final offset range and headroom are not guaranteed by preview +/-5 V controls or +/-10 V clip demo. Buffer all outputs and detect overload.

name: MULT 1
behavior: One high-impedance input, three individually buffered outputs.
engineering_to_finish: Two copies of this function only, not four 1:4 MULTs. Precision error/stability/output isolation must be budgeted; output resistor outside feedback gives load error.

name: MULT 2
behavior: One high-impedance input, three individually buffered outputs.

name: S&H 1
behavior: Condition positive trigger edge into a finite sample pulse; captured target -> separate post-hold lag -> OUT. One SAMPLE button and one SLEW pot per channel.
engineering_to_finish: No through gate tracking as default, no hidden clock/noise, no slew CV. Hold cap and lag cap different nodes. LF398 leakage/offset and acquisition must be qualified; final OUT LED sees glide.

name: SWITCH 1
behavior: Manual maintained A/B selector with IN-A, IN-B, OUT.
engineering_to_finish: Not a crossfader, sequential switch or clocked switch. Prevent output-output shorts during possible contact overlap; buffer/protect. Clicks are possible.

name: Noise
behavior: White, pink, blue, brown, separately buffered outputs from shared source basis.
engineering_to_finish: NOISE2 is a programmed digital pseudo-random source candidate. Four colors are not independent random generators. Blue/brown shaping is finite-band; no stability/DC/runaway claims.
